correctness.rationale: For every post-startup transition of \(g_t=(-1)^{t-1}G\), the source tangent-difference ratio is exactly \(2G/|1-G^2|\). Elementary trigonometry gives the cosine input \(|1-G^2|/(1+G^2)\). Reciprocal symmetry and monotonicity follow by differentiation, and equality of the two coefficients reduces to a reciprocal quartic that is solved exactly. The embedded verifier independently replays all formulas and boundary cases.

value.rationale: Angular information is the defining novelty and stated interpretation of AngularGrad, so invariance under positive rescaling is a natural structural expectation for a direction-only signal. The result shows exactly that the published statistic instead mixes direction with amplitude, gives the complete reciprocal-amplitude phase diagram, and reveals opposite unit-amplitude extrema for the two published variants. This is a motivated boundary of the method rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
